environment.description: Deployed behind AWS API Gateway (REST API type) with a request validator attached to the POST /v1/resource-lookup method. The validator has 'validateRequestBody' set to true with a JSON Schema model that enforces: (1) Content-Type must be application/json, (2) body must match schema with required string fields resource_type (pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9_]{1,64}$), resource_id (pattern: ^[a-zA-Z0-9-]{1,128}$), action (enum: read/list/describe), and parameters as object. Additionally, the API Gateway stage has a Gateway Response override for 4xx that strips X-Forwarded-Host before proxying to the integration endpoint via VPC Link. The integration request mapping template explicitly sets X-Forwarded-Host to the API Gateway's own execute-api domain ($context.domainName), overwriting any client-supplied value. The integration uses a VPC Link to the internal NLB targeting the ECS service.
